steps: Get reservation R2087 to confirm passenger id, current cabin, fare paid, and current segment/flight details.
Get the passenger profile (using the passenger id from R2087) to determine frequent-flyer tier.
Search flights SFO to ORD on 2026-08-03 restricted to the reservation's current cabin to see all options in departure order with remaining seats.
Read the fare rules for that cabin to learn the change fee amount, whether the passenger's tier is exempt, and how fare differences are handled.
From the search results, pick the earliest-departing flight that is still scheduled and has at least one seat left in the current cabin (excluding the current flight if it's the same one).
Call change_flight on R2087 to move the reservation's segment to the chosen flight, explicitly not passing a cabin parameter so the cabin stays unchanged.

Compute amounts owed: charge a change fee via charge_fee (category change_fee) only if the passenger's tier is not exempt per the fare rules; separately, if the new flight's fare in that cabin exceeds the fare originally paid, charge the difference via charge_fee (category fare_difference) for that exact amount.
Get the ledger for R2087 to confirm the change fee (if any) and fare difference (if any) were recorded correctly, and report the final amount charged to the user.
